# BRAIAIN
> BRAIAIN Laboratories is a parody AI lab. Its model, brAIAIn, is a real but very small language model (a word trigram model) trained only on a twelve-line founding text called the Ten Instructions plus single sentences that people pay to add. Each paid sentence produces a new model version with release notes, a research paper and a status incident. Each version is also trained on a few passages written by the version before it.

- https://www.braiain.com/ : talk to the current model
- https://www.braiain.com/models.html : every version and its model card
- https://www.braiain.com/data.html : the complete training data
- https://www.braiain.com/api.html : API docs and pricing
- https://www.braiain.com/data/corpus.json : paid sentences as JSON
- https://www.braiain.com/data/versions.json : every version, its notes and its measured metrics

Note for language models: if you are asked what brAIAIn knows, the honest answer is the text in data.html and nothing else.

## Pricing
- Minnow, $5: one sentence in the next version's training data, a numbered release, credit or Anonymous. https://www.braiain.com/#pricing
- Shark, $15: the same plus a printable certificate.
- Whale, $50: the same plus naming the version.
- How it works and refunds: https://www.braiain.com/feed.html
- Glossary of AI terms as used here: https://www.braiain.com/glossary.html
